points.description: Names both phases (slow start and congestion avoidance) and correctly describes how cwnd changes in each: in slow start cwnd grows exponentially (increases by 1 per acknowledged segment, i.e. doubles each RTT) while cwnd < ss_thresh; in congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh) cwnd grows only linearly/slowly (e.g. +1 after all segments of a window are acknowledged). Also states that on packet loss/congestion ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark requires both phases named with correct cwnd behaviour (exponential in slow start, linear in congestion avoidance) and the loss reaction (ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1). Missing or incorrect elements earn no mark; the single mark is all-or-nothing.
